title: The Library Card
text:
Last week, I visited the town library for the first time. It was larger than I expected, with bright windows and comfortable chairs.

A woman at the desk helped me get a library card. I wrote my name and address on a form. The card was free.

I wanted a book about cooking, but I also found a short story collection. I could borrow both books for three weeks.

Before I left, I saw a poster for a reading group. It meets every Thursday evening. Next week, I am going to join them.
textTranslate:
上周，我第一次去了镇上的图书馆。它比我想象的更大，有明亮的窗户和舒适的椅子。

服务台的一位女士帮我办了借书卡。我在一张表格上填写了姓名和地址。办卡是免费的。

我本来想找一本烹饪书，但还发现了一本短篇故事集。我可以把这两本书都借走，借期三周。

离开之前，我看到了一张读书会海报。读书会每周四晚上举行。我打算下周加入他们。

title: A Weekend by Train
text:
My cousin and I wanted to spend a weekend by the sea. We decided to travel by train because neither of us had a car.

We bought our tickets online on Friday. The early train was cheaper, so we had to get up at half past five.

When we arrived, the weather was windy but dry. We walked along the beach and found a cafe that sold hot soup.

On the way home, we were tired and our shoes were full of sand. Still, we agreed that a short trip could make a big difference.
textTranslate:
表哥和我想去海边过一个周末。我们都没有汽车，所以决定坐火车去。

我们周五在网上买了票。早班火车比较便宜，所以我们不得不五点半就起床。

到达时，天气有风，但没有下雨。我们沿着海滩散步，找到了一家卖热汤的咖啡馆。

回家的路上，我们很累，鞋里全是沙子。尽管如此，我们都觉得一次短途旅行也能带来很大的变化。

title: My Balcony Garden
text:
I do not have a garden, but my flat has a small balcony. In March, I bought three pots and some tomato seeds.

At first, nothing happened. I checked the pots every day and gave them a little water. After two weeks, I saw tiny green leaves.

My neighbour told me that the plants needed more sunlight. I moved them to the other side of the balcony, where they grew much faster.

By July, I had my first red tomato. It was very small, but I shared it with my neighbour. Growing food took time, and that made it special.
textTranslate:
我没有花园，但公寓有一个小阳台。三月，我买了三个花盆和一些番茄种子。

起初，什么动静都没有。我每天查看花盆，给它们浇一点水。两周后，我看到了小小的绿叶。

邻居告诉我，植物需要更多阳光。我把它们搬到阳台的另一侧，它们在那里长得快多了。

到了七月，我收获了第一个红番茄。它很小，但我还是和邻居一起分享了它。种食物需要时间，这也让收获格外珍贵。

title: A Recipe from Home
text:
When I moved to a new city, I missed my family dinners. One evening, I called my father and asked him how to make his vegetable noodles.

He told me to cut the carrots into small pieces and cook them first. Then I needed to add the noodles and some green vegetables.

I forgot to buy onions, and I put in too much salt. My dinner did not taste exactly like his, but it was warm and filling.

Now I cook these noodles every Sunday. I am getting better at it. Sometimes a simple meal is the easiest way to feel closer to home.
textTranslate:
搬到一个新城市后，我很想念和家人共进晚餐的日子。一天晚上，我打电话问爸爸，怎样做他拿手的蔬菜面。

他让我把胡萝卜切成小块，先煮胡萝卜。然后再加入面条和一些绿叶蔬菜。

我忘了买洋葱，盐也放多了。晚餐的味道和爸爸做的并不完全一样，但吃起来热乎又饱腹。

现在我每周日都会做这种面。我做得越来越好了。有时，一顿简单的饭就是让自己感觉更接近家乡的最容易的方法。
